newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF Sakakibara to speak at Japan forum on Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: MOF Sakakibara to speak at Japan forum on Nov 14.

text.p: Senior Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara plans to speak at a meeting hosted by the Jiyu Seikei forum on November 14, a ministry official said on Friday.
The official did not say what Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, would discuss at the forum, which will start at 0830 GMT.

Sakakibara, dubbed "Mr Yen" by the foreign media, is said to have been the key figure in driving the dollar above 100 yen last year through aggressive government intervention in foreign exchange markets.
